raw.title: BNB Hits New ATH at $800 as Altseason Index Holds Above 50 – Is Altseason Finally Here?
raw.description: Binance Coin (BNB) reached a new all-time high of $800 as the Altcoin Season Index climbed to 51, prompting Binance founder CZ to predict "FOMO season" may be approaching amid growing evidence of capital rotation from Bitcoin into alternative cryptocurrencies.
